step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify actors and services: User icon (UserCompanyDeveloper), EC2 instances running Hadoop (EC2), custom Token Vending Service (ThirdParty), internal LDAP Directory (ThirdParty), AWS STS (STS), Managed Policies MP1 and MP2 (IAM), and S3 Buckets (S3).
2. Trace connections based on physical whiteboard arrows:
   - User connects to EC2 via Kerberos.
   - EC2 credentials provider requests tokens from Token Vending Service.
   - Token Vending queries LDAP for group memberships.
   - Token Vending calls STS AssumeRole with specific managed policies.
   - STS applies Managed Policy 1 (MP1) and Managed Policy 2 (MP2).
   - MP1 grants access to S3 Bucket 1 and MP2 grants access to S3 Bucket 2.
   - EC2 uses the returned STS tokens to directly access data in S3.
